jobs.title: Head of Frontend Engineering
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Head of Frontend Engineeringto lead a large engineering unit (~70+ engineers, including Team Leads) and drive the development of our frontend direction, engineering culture, and product quality.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Head of Frontend Engineeringto lead a large engineering unit (~70+ engineers, including Team Leads) and drive the development of our frontend direction, engineering culture, and product quality.

This is a systems and leadership role, focused on scaling teams, improving engineering processes, and influencing architecture — not day-to-day hands-on development.

Your Mission:

  • Lead the frontend organization (engineering + UI/design teams), ~70+ engineers

  • Scale teams through Team Leads and develop engineering leaders

  • Build and evolve engineering culture, standards, and best practices

  • Design and improve development and delivery processes

  • Ensure quality, stability, and predictability of product delivery

  • Participate in architectural decisions (including microfrontend approach)

  • Manage technical debt and improve system sustainability

  • Drive hiring and development of key engineering talent

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Backend, and Design teams

Your Unique Contribution:

  • 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing 40+ people through Team Leads

  • Proven experience scaling engineering organizations and delivery processes

  • Strong background in frontend development

  • Experience developing engineers and tech leads (mentoring, performance management, growth planning)

  • Understanding of complex frontend architectures

  • Experience with high-load web applications

  • Strong communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams

  • Fluency in Russian is required for effective day-to-day collaboration within the engineering team

Technology context:

  • Vue (2/3) / React

  • TypeScript

  • State management: Pinia, Vuex and similar solutions

  • Microfrontend architecture (Webpack Module Federation)

  • Webpack

  • Jest and unit testing

What’s in It for You:

  • Leadership of a large frontend engineering organization (~70+ engineers)

  • Strong influence on architecture and core product direction

  • Highly skilled engineering and leadership team

  • Remote-first work format or office option

  • Competitive compensation (discussed individually)

  • Opportunity to shape engineering processes and strategy

  • Learning & development support (training, conferences, knowledge sharing)

  • Open and collaborative environment where you can actively shape systems, not just maintain them

Excited about the opportunity? If you're ready for a career that will challenge and energize you, let’s chat!

jobs.title: Frontend Developer [NovelAI]
jobs.excerpt: Description Anlatan is a company working on cutting edge AI and making the best possible AI-fueled products.
jobs.description:
Description
Anlatan is a company working on cutting edge AI and making the best possible AI-fueled products. We pride ourselves on being user-friendly, privacy-safe, and censorship-free. We're a ragtag team of personalities, focused on crafting the best of the best in the AI world.
We're looking for a talented Frontend Developer to join our dynamic team at Anlatan. You'll be working closely with the rest of our team to implement updates, fix bugs, and rapidly build up our products. You'll need to accurately implement mockups from our Designer, help test internal AI-related features, and assist in brainstorming new ideas with the rest of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Write clean and productive code across the entire frontend stack.
  • Quickly find and squash bugs found both internally and by the users.
  • Work and communicate with the rest of the Anlatan team to efficiently build and ship updates.
  • Implement finalized User Interface design mockups.
  • Provide input into new and developing ideas with the rest of the Anlatan team.

Requirements

  • Experience with Frontend frameworks such as React.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, and Typescript.
  • Experience in managing large and ever-changing codebases.
  • A strong background in computer science, with in-depth knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and software design principles.
  • Being able to utilize Git for version control and collaboration.
Why work for us?
We're working fast to send ripples through the ever-moving field of AI, we offer a competitive salary package, and of course, we're all pretty fun to work with.
We offer a competitive salary and benefits, including:
- A casual and flexible work environment
- A culture focused on pushing the envelope and having fun while doing it
- Incredibly flexible PTO
For US Citizens
- Health Insurance
- Vision and Dental Insurance
- Life Insurance and Disability
- 401k (3% Match 100%, 2% Match 50%)
For non-US Citizens
- Health Insurance
- Vision and Dental Insurance
Beyond all else, our members are encouraged to:
1. Explore and Experiment
Unless we’re completely focused on getting a specific feature done, feel free to try something new out! Every idea brought to the table is appreciated and discussed.
2. Work Stress-free
We’re here to push boundaries in the AI consumer world, but that doesn’t mean you can’t have a little fun along the way. Our entire team emerged from the internet, so we’re a long ways from professional.
3. Ask For Help
No one is all-knowing. Sometimes all you need a little poke in the right direction to get something done. Never be afraid to reach out if it means getting your problem solved sooner rather than later.
4. Interact with the Community
Our community is what keeps us going, and we try to recognize that every single day. A primary goal of ours is to stay connected, and we pursue that by keeping in touch with our users through multiple different mediums.
